from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquityInfo(BaseModel):
    """One company's equity data extracted from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as reported")
    equity_amount: float | None = Field(description="Amount of '归属于母公司股东权益' (Owner's equity attributable to shareholders of the parent company)")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the reported amount (e.g., 'CNY', '元')")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the financial report (e.g., '2024 Q1')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    equity_records: list[CompanyEquityInfo]
